killedBy: createStatsStore: the CAMPAIGN RUN scope SURVIVES the tab closing, which is the entire reason it is persisted
why: Accumulates the run tally in memory and never writes it, which is the whole design decision reversed in one line. Everything passes within a single browser session -- which is how a campaign is usually played while testing -- and a campaign spread over two sittings silently reports only the second one, on the screen built to report it. Anchored on the tail of `record` plus the closing brace, because `writeRaw(RUN_STATS_KEY, runTally)` also appears in `startRun` and `resetStats` and those writes are a different claim.
